heroDescription: Pick the pieces, build a sentence and discover English at your own pace.
lessonBadge: ENGLISH · ONE SENTENCE AT A TIME
activityOneDescription: Five sentences to explore. You can go back whenever you like.
activityTwoTitle: Ready to go a little further?
activityTwoDescription: Now it’s your turn. Use what you learned to build two more sentences.
instructions: Pick the pieces in the right order to build the sentence.
reorderHint: Use the arrows to change the order. Select a piece in your sentence to remove it.
correct: Well done! Your sentence is in the right order.
incorrect: Try another order. A hint can help!
incomplete: Use all the pieces to complete the sentence.
idle: Pick a piece to get started.
tipOne: Look at the first word: a capital letter can give you a clue.
tipTwo: Think about who does the action and what happens in the sentence.
tipThree: You can try again. Learning is about experimenting, too.
keyboardHint: Use Tab to navigate and Enter or Space to select. The arrows on each piece change its position.
footer: Made for learning. One word at a time.
resetAnnouncement: Sentence {current} of {total} cleared. Pick the pieces again.
loadError: The activities could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.
noscript: Enable JavaScript to build sentences and practice English.
completionDescription: Look at your sentences again or start a new round at your own pace.
questionInstruction: Pick the pieces and build the sentence in English.
promptFries: Tell us which food you love.
promptHero: A sentence about power and responsibility.
promptSteps: Small steps can make a difference.
hintCat: Start with who does the action: “The cat”.
hintHero: Start with “With”. Think about what comes with great power.
hintLearning: Look for the piece about gaining knowledge: “Learning”.
hintSteps: Start with “Small steps”. What can they make?
